topic.title: Safe Exploration and Constrained Reinforcement Learning
topic.overview: Safe reinforcement learning seeks reward while respecting limits on risk, state violations, or resource use. These papers distinguish safety during exploration from safety of the final policy. Intervention mechanisms, reachability estimates, constrained value functions, and separate reward-and-cost critics address different parts of that problem.
topic.whyItMatters: An agent can learn a successful final behavior only after taking unacceptable actions during training. Practical guarantees must specify whether they bound cumulative cost, violation probability, or persistent state-wise safety, because these are different requirements.
topic.evolution: Early representatives concern robust motion planning and safe exploration. Later work develops constrained-MDP formulations and advantage-based interventions. Recent papers analyze feasible-set reachability and multiple simultaneous constraints, including how shared critics can become biased as Lagrange multipliers change. The emphasis shifts across papers between formal guarantees and deployable learning procedures.
openQuestions: How can safety be maintained when reachability estimates are uncertain?
Which constraint formulations best reflect irreversible consequences rather than average cost?

papers.title: Enhancing Efficiency of Safe Reinforcement Learning via Sample Manipulation

papers.title: Excluding the Irrelevant: Focusing Reinforcement Learning through Continuous Action Masking

papers.title: Flipping-based Policy for Chance-Constrained Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Last-Iterate Global Convergence of Policy Gradients for Constrained Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: RA-PbRL: Provably Efficient Risk-Aware Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Regularization for Safe Control of Critical Systems

papers.title: Risk-sensitive control as inference with Rényi divergence
papers.tldr: Rényi-divergence inference provides a unified formulation of risk-sensitive control and corresponding reinforcement-learning methods.

papers.title: Robust Reinforcement Learning with General Utility
papers.tldr: A robust general-utility RL framework provides gradient-convergence guarantees and, under a polyhedral uncertainty condition, convergence to global optimality.

papers.title: Safe Time-Varying Optimization based on Gaussian Processes with Spatio-Temporal Kernel
papers.tldr: TVSAFEOPT tracks changing safe regions through spatio-temporal Bayesian optimization and provides optimality guarantees when the problem becomes stationary.

papers.title: Safety through feedback in Constrained RL
papers.tldr: The method learns safety costs from trajectory-level feedback and uses novelty-based queries to reduce evaluation effort.

papers.title: Simplifying Constraint Inference with Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: A simplified constraint-inference framework learns safety aspects from demonstrations while matching or improving prior continuous-control benchmark performance.

papers.title: Solving Minimum-Cost Reach Avoid using Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Spectral-Risk Safe Reinforcement Learning with Convergence Guarantees

papers.title: Test Where Decisions Matter: Importance-driven Testing for Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: A model-based testing framework prioritizes safety-critical decisions and can establish formal policy guarantees from evaluating only a fraction of its behavior.

papers.title: Time-Constrained Robust MDPs
papers.tldr: Time-Constrained Robust MDPs model correlated, time-dependent disturbances and improve the performance–robustness tradeoff in evaluated control tasks.

papers.title: Verified Safe Reinforcement Learning for Neural Network Dynamic Models
papers.tldr: Curriculum learning, incremental verification, and initial-state-specific controllers extend formally verified safety horizons while retaining high reward in evaluated control problems.

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Machine Learning Framework for Safe and Optimal Control of Autonomous Systems
papers.tldr: The framework combines constrained optimal control, physics-informed learning, and conformal verification to learn controllers with high-confidence safety and quantified performance error.

papers.title: A Reduction Framework for Distributionally Robust Reinforcement Learning under Average Reward

papers.title: A Reductions Approach to Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning with Optimized Certainty Equivalents

papers.title: ABNet: Adaptive explicit-Barrier Net for Safe and Scalable Robot Learning

papers.title: An Optimistic Algorithm for online CMDPS with Anytime Adversarial Constraints
papers.tldr: OMDPD bounds regret and constraint violations under adversarially changing constraints without requiring a known strictly safe policy.

papers.title: Beyond CVaR: Leveraging Static Spectral Risk Measures for Enhanced Decision-Making in Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: A distributional reinforcement learning algorithm optimizes broader static risk objectives with convergence guarantees and interpretable policy behavior.

papers.title: C2IQL: Constraint-Conditioned Implicit Q-learning for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: C2IQL combines implicit offline learning, reconstructed cumulative costs, and constraint conditioning to improve rewards while meeting tested safety thresholds.

papers.title: Controlling Underestimation Bias in Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Safe Exploration

papers.title: Decision Theoretic Foundations for Conformal Prediction: Optimal Uncertainty Quantification for Risk-Averse Agents

papers.title: Extreme Value Policy Optimization for Safe Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Fast and Robust: Task Sampling with Posterior and Diversity Synergies for Adaptive Decision-Makers in Randomized Environments

papers.title: Learning Safe Control via On-the-Fly Bandit Exploration

papers.title: Off-Policy Actor-Critic for Adversarial Observation Robustness: Virtual Alternative Training via Symmetric Policy Evaluation

papers.title: PIGDreamer: Privileged Information Guided World Models for Safe Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Preference Controllable Reinforcement Learning with Advanced Multi-Objective Optimization

papers.title: Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Stochastic Adversary

papers.title: RobustZero: Enhancing MuZero Reinforcement Learning Robustness to State Perturbations

papers.title: Safe-EF: Error Feedback for Non-smooth Constrained Optimization

papers.title: Safety Certificate against Latent Variables with Partially Unidentifiable Dynamics

papers.title: Safety-Polarized and Prioritized Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Simple Policy Optimization

papers.title: When Maximum Entropy Misleads Policy Optimization

papers.title: A Provable Approach for End-to-End Safe Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Adaptable Safe Policy Learning from Multi-task Data with Constraint Prioritized Decision Transformer

papers.title: Adversarial Diffusion for Robust Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Automaton Constrained Q-Learning

papers.title: Boundary-to-Region Supervision for Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Efficient Policy Optimization in Robust Constrained MDPs with Iteration Complexity Guarantees

papers.title: Efficient Safe Meta-Reinforcement Learning: Provable Near-Optimality and Anytime Safety

papers.title: Enhancing Safety in Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback via Rectified Policy Optimization
papers.tldr: RePO improves safety alignment by penalizing prompt-level safety violations that average constraints can conceal.

papers.title: Explainably Safe Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Fuz-RL: A Fuzzy-Guided Robust Framework for Safe Reinforcement Learning under Uncertainty
papers.tldr: Fuz-RL uses fuzzy measures to formulate robust safe reinforcement learning without min-max optimization and improves tested safety and control performance.

papers.title: HMARL-CBF – Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Critical Autonomous Systems

papers.title: HypRL: Reinforcement Learning of Control Policies for Hyperproperties

papers.title: Linear Mixture Distributionally Robust Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Online Constrained MDPs

papers.title: Offline Guarded Safe Reinforcement Learning for Medical Treatment Optimization Strategies

papers.title: Planning and Learning in Average Risk-aware MDPs

papers.title: Real-DRL: Teach and Learn at Runtime

papers.title: Risk-Averse Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Optimized Certainty Equivalents
papers.tldr: This framework adds OCE-based risk awareness to constrained reinforcement learning, with conditional duality guarantees and a wrapper for standard solvers.

papers.title: Robust Reinforcement Learning in Finance: Modeling Market Impact with Elliptic Uncertainty Sets

papers.title: SafeVLA: Towards Safety Alignment of Vision-Language-Action Model via Constrained Learning

papers.title: SPiDR: A Simple Approach for Zero-Shot Safety in Sim-to-Real Transfer

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Control of Conditional Value-at-Risk via Rockafellar-Uryasev Conformal Inference

papers.title: Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Action Conditional Guarantee

papers.title: Constrained Meta Reinforcement Learning with Provable Test-Time Safety

papers.title: Constrained Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Max-Min Criterion
papers.tldr: This framework combines max-min fairness with explicit constraints in multi-objective reinforcement learning.

papers.title: CORAL: Uncertainty-Aware Regulation of Exposure Concentration in Recommender Systems

papers.title: CSPO: Constraint-Sensitive Policy Optimization for Safe Reinforcement Learning

papers.title: Doubly Regularized Markov Decision Processes for Robust Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Regularizing both policies and dynamics yields a robust reinforcement learning framework with finite-sample guarantees and practical algorithmic variants.

papers.title: Hybrid Reinforcement Learning in Adversarial Markov Decision Processes

papers.title: Knothe-Rosenblatt Quantile Regression for Risk-sensitive Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning

papers.tldr: The paper develops near-minimax multi-objective learning guarantees that respect when preferences and rewards become available.
